title: Tom Farmer, CIA general counsel, vetting Paperclip Germans

tellings.quote: I was going to say it turned out he was involved in in the project called Paperclip.

plain: Harold Malmgren, a former adviser to US presidents, was talking on Jesse Michels' podcast about a man named Tom Farmer, who served as general counsel, meaning top lawyer, for the CIA, America's foreign intelligence agency. Malmgren says Farmer told him he had been involved in Project Paperclip, the US effort after the Second World War to bring German scientists to America, and that his job was checking out those Germans in Germany and Washington. If true, it would put a senior CIA lawyer close to the people and secrets that came over from Germany.
